description: Snapshot of the scripts that generated the residential (house), industrial (factory) and museum buildings. house/ and archive/ are byte-identical to their origin. factory/ and museum/ are identical to their origin except that versioned file names were replaced by role names (renamed_modules); every occurrence of an old module name inside the files was replaced by the new one and nothing else changed, so substituting the names back reproduces original_sha256 exactly (tests/test_generation_snapshot.py checks this). 'contract' records whether a frozen contract manifest written by the original run lists the original SHA-256. factory/ is the final Round 4 runner (run_batch.py), every tool it calls, and the 14 helper modules those tools import from earlier rounds; the earlier revisions recorded by the 27 READY Factory80 runs are listed under 'superseded'. museum/ is the import closure of the Museum29 generator, exporter, Isaac C5/RTX runners and static validators, plus the 29 design specs. archive/factory_pilots/ holds the earlier stacked and tiled industrial pilots.
